sprint_goal: Migrate customer profile data from PostgreSQL to MongoDB with dual-write capability, ensuring zero data loss, backward-compatible API, and validated parity within three weeks.

tasks.title: Design flexible MongoDB schema for customer data
tasks.description: Define MongoDB collections and document structures supporting country-specific fields (e.g., My Number, VAT ID). Include validation rules and indexes for performance.

tasks.title: Implement PostgreSQL to MongoDB CDC pipeline
tasks.description: Configure change data capture to stream updates from PostgreSQL to MongoDB using stable connector or AWS DMS. Monitor data consistency throughout backfill.

tasks.title: Implement dual-write mechanism in customer API layer
tasks.description: Modify API to perform writes to both PostgreSQL and MongoDB with transactional consistency and retry logic on failure.

tasks.title: Add feature flag for gradual rollout
tasks.description: Integrate feature flag controls to toggle MongoDB reads/writes. Enable controlled rollout per environment without downtime.

tasks.title: Define MongoDB indexing strategy
tasks.description: Identify query patterns and create appropriate indexes to ensure read latency <50ms p95. Validate index efficiency under simulated load.

tasks.title: Set up MongoDB replica set cluster in AWS
tasks.description: Deploy 3-node MongoDB cluster in AWS (us-east-1). Configure replica set, connection strings, and monitoring dashboards.

tasks.title: Perform full data validation and parity check
tasks.description: Implement validation scripts to compare all 2M records between PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Generate reports highlighting mismatches for correction.

tasks.title: Create and test rollback procedure
tasks.description: Document and automate rollback to PostgreSQL within 1 hour. Validate switch-over steps and ensure no data corruption.

risks.description: CDC pipeline may cause latency or miss updates during high traffic periods.
risks.mitigation: Implement retry and checkpoint mechanisms. Monitor with alerts on lag exceeding 2 seconds.

risks.description: Dual-write logic could cause data inconsistency during network issues.
risks.mitigation: Add transactional retry logic and compare write success metrics between databases.

risks.description: MongoDB performance may not meet <50ms read latency requirements.
risks.mitigation: Tune indexes and validate query performance using production-like dataset before cutover.

risks.description: Rollback procedure may be untested leading to prolonged downtime if required.
risks.mitigation: Perform rollback dry-run before final migration to confirm process reliability.

definition_of_done: All API writes go to both MongoDB and PostgreSQL during dual-write phase
Feature flag rollout tested in staging and production environments
MongoDB read latency validated under expected traffic (<50ms p95)
Rollback procedure documented and tested successfully
